ny-petit-larceny.name: Petit Larceny
ny-petit-larceny.description: Stealing property valued at $1,000 or less under New York Penal Law § 155.25. One of the most commonly charged offenses in New York courts.
ny-petit-larceny.maxPenalty: Class A misdemeanor: up to 1 year jail and/or $1,000 fine

ny-criminal-possession-of-stolen-propert.name: Criminal Possession of Stolen Property
ny-criminal-possession-of-stolen-propert.description: Knowingly possessing stolen property with intent to benefit from it under New York Penal Law § 165.40 (fifth degree, property value $1,000 or less)
ny-criminal-possession-of-stolen-propert.maxPenalty: Class A misdemeanor: up to 1 year jail and/or $1,000 fine

ny-vandalism.name: Vandalism
ny-vandalism.description: Destruction of property under New York law
ny-vandalism.maxPenalty: Up to 1 year jail and/or fines

ny-trespass-after-warning.name: Trespass After Warning / Return After Ban
ny-trespass-after-warning.description: Returning to or remaining on property after receiving a formal trespass warning or being banned from the premises under NY law
ny-trespass-after-warning.maxPenalty: Up to 1 year jail and/or $1,000 fine
